conversations.answer: Let's refactor the given Loader component to use functional components instead of class components. Functional components with hooks are the more modern way to write React components as of the last updates leading up to 2021.Here's the refactored component:[CODE_BLOCK_0]This refactored code is more concise and is in line with the more modern and recommended way of writing React components.

Let's refactor the given Hero component to use a functional component. We'll also utilize React's useContext hook to access the ThemeContext.[CODE_BLOCK_0]Changes made:Used a functional component instead of a class component.Used the useContext hook to get the theme from ThemeContext.Destructured the props directly in the function arguments for better clarity.Replaced join(' ') with template literals for better readability when combining class names.Removed the unused import (toJS from mobx). If it's necessary elsewhere, you can add it back.

Let's refactor the Heading component to be a functional component. This refactor will also simplify the conditional logic and improve readability:[CODE_BLOCK_0]Changes made:Converted to a functional component.Destructured the props directly in the function arguments for better clarity.Simplified the conditional logic by creating a Tag variable to determine the heading tag dynamically.Used the dynamic Tag component to render the appropriate heading.
